string.text: Player-only visual detection. Scales stock visibility, then multiplies by a pose factor (stand / crouch / prone). Does not change NPC-vs-NPC vision, sound, or AlifeTactics. Tip: turn off AlifeTactics Disclosure "Turn on the shooter" so wounds do not fake seen-class.
Multiply stock visibility (light x velocity x range falloff) before pose factors. 0-1.
Visibility multiplier while standing (or any non-crouch/prone pose). Lower = stealthier. Default 1.0.
Visibility multiplier while crouching (not prone). Lower = stealthier. Default 0.70.
Visibility multiplier while prone (crouch + accel / True Prone). Lower = stealthier. Default 0.30.
Small bottom-center gem showing your final visibility after pose multiply (brighter = more visible).
Show last scaled vis, active pose multiplier, and output on the actor message line.
